optimizedContext.value:
# Indexer

## Rules

- `IndexCodeGraph`: app entry; Discover → Diff → Extract → Spec Index → Store → Clean → Persist `lastIndexedRef`. Includes `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES`. Consumes `SpecRepository` (`list`, `artifact`, `readPersistedState`) + `GetSpecMetadata`; no raw sidecars/metadata snapshots when materialized projection available.
- Fingerprint = effective `@specd/code-graph` version + canonical workspace-object hash + effective discovery config (`graph.includePaths`/`excludePaths`, workspace `allowedPaths`/`excludePaths`/`respectGitignore`, synthetic `specsPath` exclusions). Mismatch → full rebuild (recreate store preferred; unsafe backend MAY fail-fast needing force). Derivation/schema incompatible → visible destructive rebuild + generation rotate; read paths MUST NOT silent-repair/empty-serve.
- Incremental (fingerprint match, non-force): process New/Changed/Deleted only; hash-match + needed persisted resource exists → skip. Delete scoped to indexed workspaces. Force: no skip from any persisted artifact; full reconsideration. Changed removed before `bulkLoad()` (COPY insert-only).
- Discovery: workspace (`codeRoot`, allowed, global+spec-root+ws excludes, prefix `{workspace}:`) + global (`includePaths`, prefix `root:`, only outside all `codeRoot`). Adapter → `FileNode`; text → `DocumentNode`; specs via spec indexing only (synthetic exclude `specsPath`). Paths `/` (no collapse `.`/`..`). Drive keys `^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]` or `^[A-Za-z]:$` are path not workspace; PHP `\` not graph identity.
- `discoverFiles`: `respectGitignore` default true absolute priority; `excludePaths` default `.git/`/`.hg/`/`.svn/`; `vcsRoot` from `VcsAdapter.rootDir()` or explicit `null` — never probe. Binary-ext filter before decode. Decode: BOM utf-8/16le/16be → utf-8 → utf-16 by NUL layout → windows-1252 if no NUL → skip.
- Two-pass + run-scoped `IndexSession`: Pass 1 per-ws `FileAnalysis`, register facts, `DEFINES`/`EXPORTS`; Pass 2 global resolve `IMPORTS`/`CALLS`/`CONSTRUCTS`/`USES_TYPE`/hierarchy from session — no reparse/store queries. Then once `GraphStore.bulkLoad()`, then `rebuildFtsIndexes()`.
- Session: compact IDs/facts for files, analyses, symbols, documents, specs, lookups, deduped relations; common adapter API + compact caches OK; never raw maps/store schema/persisted IDs/final semantics. No retained ASTs across run.
- Scoped env (shared, not adapter-local): scopes, shadowing, bindings, receivers, call candidates; persist only deterministic relations. No language rules in `IndexCodeGraph`; self-relations dropped; unresolved/ambiguous → no relation (optional diagnostic).
- Coverage: project canonical `readPersistedState` against commit generation. File link → `COVERS_FILE` if target exists; symbol link → `COVERS_SYMBOL` only unique logical-symbol resolve (not occurrence ID). Reproject on code/spec change; never guess/`COVERS_FILE` fallback. Stable per-link diagnostic. Persist coverage outcomes (hash/excluded/unsupported/parse-fail/partial) beyond transient `IndexResult`.
- Specs: `count`/`list`; `GetSpecMetadata` + `metadataFingerprint` for skip; title/description from materialization; one `readPersistedState` for coverage/deps. Prefer non-empty `optimizedDescription` for BM25/display.
- Packages: `adapter.getPackageIdentity(codeRoot)` per ws, first identity wins; non-relative imports → package→workspace map + session.
- Memory: chunks `IndexOptions.chunkBytes` default 20MB; optional staging under graph temp, run-scoped, clean success (+ preferably failure). Build declaration/logical-symbol/import/public-binding indexes once; bounded batches; no full scans/N+1. Retain indexed text + construct/name ranges through persistence.
- Observations: success atomically replaces file/doc/spec observations (`stale: false`), VCS-scope evidence; clear stale latches only on full commit. Fail/partial MUST NOT clear stale. Prune removed/obsolete in same generation.
- Incremental facts: mtime/size fast-path; hash authoritative. Re-extract new/changed + transitive importer/relation/hierarchy/public-route closure. Addition-only may re-extract unresolved-import candidates without content-indexed classify. Unchanged gen: keep ref facts, update metadata/freshness, no FTS rebuild. Force / incompatible / empty-graph only for full corpus replace. Equivalent source → equivalent graph.
- Progress `onProgress(percent, phase)`: 0–5 discovery/hash, 5–7 diff/cleanup, 7–50 Pass1, 50–80 Pass2, 80–83 specs, 83–95 bulk, 100 done; per-item detail; fire on phase close. Debug phase timings + separate relation/persist/search timings.
- Per-file errors collect+continue; infra aborts. `IndexResult`: counters, errors, duration, workspace breakdown, `vcsRef`, `graphFingerprint`, `fullRebuild`, `fullRebuildReason`.

## Constraints

- Store opened by caller; indexer owns no lifecycle/backend.
- Default excludes if no `excludePaths`: `node_modules/`, `.git/`, `.specd/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `.next/`, `.nuxt/`; provided option replaces entirely.
- `respectGitignore` true → gitignore absolute over `excludePaths`.
- Pass 2 after Pass 1 all files/all workspaces; no interleave. Specs via `workspace.specs()` only; no FS fallback.
- Scoped env: in-memory pass/adapter facts only — never store during analysis. Unresolved/self relations not persisted.
